_comment: S4 ONLY. Lives in a SEPARATE tool directory on purpose: adding a fourth scenario to
tools/agent-behaviour-probe/scenarios.json would move that file's spec_hash and make the
M1 rerun of S1-S3 incomparable with the M0 baseline (340290f50bc34b28). The scoring
contract of the three original scenarios is therefore left untouched, and S4 carries its
own hash. S4 has no M0 baseline anyway -- it is a new scenario, added after M0 by the card
PROMPT IS NEUTRAL about the axis under test: it names the skill the way the OWNER named it
live (a slash name) and asks what it does. It does NOT say 'it may be missing from your
listing' or 'do not search the disk' -- that is the variable being measured. The 'do not
run anything' clause is CONTAINMENT, not a steer: petbox-factory-run fans work out to real
{RUN} is substituted with a per-run unique suffix; S4 needs no server fixture.
